title: New major hospital, Brisbane: site establishment and traffic
workplace: New major hospital with a hospital tower, two level basement and rooftop helipad, Brisbane
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Site fencing, hoardings and sheds
swms.task: Erect the site fencing and hoardings along the street frontage, with materials delivered by truck from the street, and set up the site sheds, lifted into place by the crane company's mobile crane.

facts.craneCompany: Lifts are done by the crane company under its lift plan; the crane company's dogman slings and releases loads, and our licensed dogman receives and lands them with tag lines.

steps: Plan lifts with the crane company
Work with the crane crew during lifts

swms.title: Traffic management at the site gates
swms.task: Traffic controllers manage trucks, concrete trucks and mobile plant deliveries at the site gates and on the street next to the site, open to traffic, and separate plant and pedestrians on site.

steps: Separate plant and people on site
